axis_rationale: axis is n, B held fixed at 64: B's effect is on the estimate (inflation, measured in v2b), n's effect is on the radius; only radius shrink can bring an inflated estimate across nominal.

mechanism_finding.PLATEAU_IS_SUPPORTED: coverage 0.9825 (393/400) at n=60k, 80k AND 107k across radii 0.0352, 0.0305, 0.0263 -- past n=60k further shrinkage buys nothing. Signature of a fixed tail mass, "threshold reached and stable", not a crossing phenomenon.
mechanism_finding.RETRACTED_2026-09-19: The version of this block written earlier today asserted "inflation decays, the radius shrinks, so the shrinking radius no longer covers a fixed bias". That MECHANISM WAS ALREADY WITHDRAWN on 2026-09-17 and is refuted by this same ladder: at fixed B=64 the excess-bias-to-radius ratio FALLS by 50x as n grows (0.407 at n=20k to 0.008 at n=107k) while coverage gets WORSE (1.0000 to 0.9825). If bias drove the breach, coverage would recover at large n. It does not. The retracted wording was re-derived without reading the existing withdrawal note in coverage_calibration_ladder.md, and it implies the problem is self-limiting, which the data contradicts.
mechanism_finding.SUPPORTED_MECHANISM: The breach is a WIDENING LOWER TAIL, not a shifting centre. Every cell's failure condition requires tv_hat to fall BELOW the truth: thresholds 0.339-0.374 against a true TV of 0.400 (6-15% below), while every median tv_hat sits at or above 0.400 and the median is flat (~0.40) as coverage falls. Block dependence widens the lower tail relative to the i.i.d. radius, so radius shrinkage cannot close it.
mechanism_finding.answers: the external review's Q4 in the negative: no amount of extra n restores nominal coverage under this dependence structure, so a correction must change the ESTIMATOR, not the sample size.
mechanism_finding.caveat: one generator, conc=0.1, B=64, true TV=0.4, 400 replicates per cell. 0.9825 has CP95 [0.9643, 0.9929], so at 400 replicates the shortfall sits near the edge of resolvability; the direction and the plateau are the findings, not the magnitude. This ladder is a SEPARATE experiment (400 replicates) from the paper's 200-replicate B=64 endpoint claim, and any use in the manuscript must name which experiment supports it.

purpose: locate the n at which coverage first falls below nominal at B=64
threshold_statement: under the shared-Dirichlet block law at concentration 0.1 with B=64, and true TV 0.4, coverage first falls below nominal (0.975) at n = 60000
why_no_verdict: A SUPPORTED/FAILED verdict invites the 'this design cannot fail' objection. The quantity of interest is a detection threshold, which is immune to that objection.
